title: Node Components: AgentTask, PackAction, ToolCall
description:
Create 3 new ReactFlow node components to replace the single generic JobNode, plus update the barrel export.

**Files (NEW):**
- `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/AgentTaskNode.tsx` — Blue accent (`bg-blue-50`), `MessageSquare` icon (lucide). Shows topic + first 30 chars of prompt from config.
- `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/PackActionNode.tsx` — Violet accent (`bg-violet-50`), `Package` icon. Shows `packId: action` from config.
- `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/ToolCallNode.tsx` — Amber accent (`bg-amber-50`), `Wrench` icon. Shows capability name from config.

**File (MODIFY):**
- `dashboard/src/components/workflow/nodes/index.ts` — Add exports for AgentTaskNode, PackActionNode, ToolCallNode.

**Pattern:** Follow existing node pattern exactly — `memo()` wrapper, `BaseNode` with icon + accent + children subtitle. See `JobNode.tsx`, `FanOutNode.tsx`, `ApprovalNode.tsx` for reference. Each truncates display text to 40 chars max. All text via JSX, no innerHTML.

**SECURITY:** All text rendered as JSX nodes, no dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
definitionOfDone: AgentTaskNode renders with MessageSquare icon, blue accent, shows topic + truncated prompt
PackActionNode renders with Package icon, violet accent, shows packId:action
ToolCallNode renders with Wrench icon, amber accent, shows capability name
All nodes use memo() wrapper and BaseNode component
index.ts barrel exports all 3 new nodes
